Verification 6C — Uploaded Document Extractor Scan
Generated: 2026-07-06 01:08:45

Purpose:
Inspect the uploaded document extractor and related upload pipeline.

We are verifying that the extractor currently performs two broad functions:
1. Article/content extraction from uploaded documents.
2. Phrase extraction / upload phrase intelligence.

Architecture rule:
For the UUCD-bound upload document pipeline, we only continue with article/content extraction.
Phrase extraction must remain separate and must not be treated as part of the UUCD article ingestion path.

7. VERIFICATION 6C DECISION TEMPLATE
============================================================

To approve 6C for the UUCD-bound article pipeline, the scan must show:

[ ] Uploaded Document Extractor exists
[ ] It extracts readable article/body text
[ ] It extracts title / H1 / headings where available
[ ] It extracts metadata where available
[ ] It supports DOCX
[ ] It supports TXT
[ ] It supports HTML / HTM
[ ] It supports MD / Markdown
[ ] Phrase extraction / phrase pool logic is identifiable as a separate path
[ ] UUCD-bound path can proceed without relying on phrase extraction
[ ] Extractor does not perform document cleaning as its main responsibility
[ ] Extractor does not create final UUCD records directly

Decision:
- APPROVE if article extraction is clearly available and phrase extraction can be separated.
- PATCH if article extraction is mixed too tightly with phrase extraction.
- SPLIT if the extractor cannot be cleanly used for article-content-only UUCD flow.
